title: Survivor Man
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Survivor Man,' Michael plans and prepares for a wilderness survival experience, inspired by reality shows, while the office deals with birthday conflicts and office dynamics. Michael's wilderness adventure involves improvising survival gear and reflecting on civilization, though the outcome remains uncertain.

main_threads.thread: Michael's Wilderness Survival Plans and Experience
